main.description: Get a thread of community posts around an anchor. Serves the same item shape as the standard thread endpoint, for content whose URI cannot be expressed as an at-uri.

anchor.description: The anchor post. A plain string, NOT declared format:at-uri, because a permissioned-space record URI is not a valid at-uri.

above.description: Whether to include parents above the anchor.

below.description: How many levels of replies to include below the anchor.

branchingFactor.description: Maximum replies to include at each level below the anchor's direct replies.

thread.description: A flat list of thread items. The depth of each item is indicated by the depth property inside the item.

errors.name: MembershipRequired
errors.description: The requester cannot view this community content.
